title: Puzzle Pirates Puzzle Room Experience For Kids
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Avast me hearties! Cap'n Peg Leg Meg needs yer help t' find the lost treasure. Ye 'n yer piratin' crew must decipher the clues 'n solve the puzzles t' find the lost loot. 
This room is recommended for kids in 1st - 5th grade.

Recommended Group Size: 2-6 kids
